history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration strengthen the process for the approval of grants with programme support costs at lower-than-stipulated rates to ensure that decisions are informed predominantly by financial impact analysis and that it maintain an audit trail for all those decisions.
history.administration_response: The Administration conducted a comprehensive review and analysis of programme support cost rates stated for all the grants that showed lower- than-stipulated rates, in cooperation with the entity responsible for the grants. In addition, the Administration has already adjusted all the grant master data in cases where the rate was not accurate, in accordance with the request of each responsible entity. A review and approval process for the request of non-standard programme support cost rates has already been put in place. Furthermore, the Administration has enhanced the grant master data to include fields to provide a justification for such rates and to upload approval memorandums where applicable.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration has conducted a comprehensive review and analysis on non-standard programme support cost rates and enhanced the grant master data, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
